name: Lootr
description: Lootr makes every loot container in the world unique per player.

pages.title: Lootr
pages.text: **Lootr** makes every loot container in the world unique per player. Two people can open the same dungeon chest and each gets a full set of loot. No more racing for the first chest.

pages.title: Loot Chest
pages.text: Generated chests turn into these. Each player sees and empties only their own copy.

pages.title: Loot Barrel
pages.text: Barrels, shulkers and decorated pots in structures follow the same rule.

**Containers you place yourself are normal.** Only containers that would roll a vanilla loot table become Lootr ones, including those in [#](2E5AAC)[structure packs](entry://exploration/structure_packs)[#](), [#](2E5AAC)[Create structures](entry://exploration/create_structures)[#]() and [#](2E5AAC)[undersea wrecks](entry://ocean/underwater_places)[#]().

pages.title: Suspicious Sand
pages.text: Archaeology blocks are covered as well.
